{"text": "If the `buffer` is an I/O stream, the function `fuzz_one_input` reads up to a predefined size `BUFFER_SIZE`.", "type": "dataflow"},

{"text": "The function `fuzz_one_input` creates a `ConjectureData` object from the `buffer`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `fuzz_one_input` calls the `execute_once` method on the test state.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "If `execute_once` raises a `StopTest` or `UnsatisfiedAssumption` exception, the function `fuzz_one_input` returns `None`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If `execute_once` raises any exception other than `StopTest` or `UnsatisfiedAssumption`, the function `fuzz_one_input` captures it.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "When an exception is captured, the function `fuzz_one_input` converts the `buffer` back to bytes and checks whether a known minimal failure exists for the same origin.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If no minimal failure exists for the same origin, or the current buffer is smaller than the known failure by the sorting key, the function `fuzz_one_input` saves the new buffer to the database and updates the minimal failures record.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "If no exceptions are raised, the function `fuzz_one_input` returns the modified `buffer` as bytes.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `fuzz_one_input` is a core component of the Hypothesis testing framework that fuzz tests an input buffer by executing it through a predefined state to find edge cases and bugs.", "type": "intent"}
